name: Moomin
title: Little House Radio

roof.note: Two identical boards with square ends; they meet at the ridge and open in either order.

hinge.item: brass butt hinge 25 × 20 mm (leaves 10 mm), holes drilled to 3.4 mm

pi.note: Portrait on the left wall, SD-card end up, GPIO edge toward the front.

battery.note: Stands on the floor against the back gable, USB-C port on top, held by hook-and-loop.

switch_cable.product: QUARKZMAN USB-C male to female extension with on/off switch, 0.28 m, 22 AWG 3 A, power only (Amazon.pl B0H1JMNHQT, pack of 2)
switch_cable.note: The listing gives no switch-body size or type: measure the body and button, then adjust the back-gable hole and spacers.

pi_lead: USB-C male to micro-USB male, up-angled micro plug, about 20 cm, 3 A
